description: Write the coach's private contact card, as the editor's form does: the whole card at once. phone with the country code (+41 79 …); channels: any of call, sms, whatsapp, signal, telegram (the ways the phone may be used); email; booking_url (https, e.g. Calendly); note (e.g. "Texts any time, calls Mon–Fri 8–18"). Their athletes see it from the moment the coach accepts them; nobody else does.
name: set_contact_card
